title: Trajectory-Triggered Sparse Collaborative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.23613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. translated_title: 轨迹触发的稀疏协作解码
translated_abstract: 诸如投机解码等稠密辅助方法需要反复使用目标模型验证草稿token，使目标模型的计算与生成过程紧密耦合。我们研究了稀疏协作解码，其中草稿模型生成大部分token，而目标模型仅在需要短暂纠正片段时才被调用。关键问题在于决定何时调用目标模型。我们证明局部不确定性是一个弱触发信号：熵、负对数似然、logit间隔、top-k概率质量和速度特征对失败的预测能力接近随机水平，AUC仅为0.50-0.53。相比之下，基于草稿置信度路径的聚合轨迹形状特征，配合仅使用草稿正确性标签训练的轻量级逻辑回归预测器，可达到0.86的AUC。这引出了一个触发时机的权衡：较早调用具有更大的干预杠杆但证据较弱，而较晚调用则证据更强但重定向轨迹的能力较弱。在线使用时，学习到的稀疏协作解码
tldr: 该论文提出利用草稿置信度路径的聚合轨迹形状特征（而非局部不确定性指标）来决定何时调用目标模型进行纠正的稀疏协作解码方法，将触发失败预测的AUC从接近随机的0.50-0.53提升至0.86，并揭示了触发时机上干预杠杆与证据强度之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sparse collaborative decoding method that triggers target model intervention based on aggregate trajectory-shape features of the draft confidence path rather than local uncertainty, improving failure prediction AUC from near-chance 0.50-0.53 to 0.86, while revealing a tradeoff between intervention leverage and evidence strength in trigger timing.
